domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将轮轨接触处几何关系按刚性接触约束处理的假设。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道及列车—轨道—桥梁动力模型的接触简化：在轮轨保持接触时忽略法向弹性压缩，通过几何协调约束连接车辆与钢轨的运动，并据此耦合系统方程。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: This model is founded on the basis of an assumption: wheel–rail rigid contact.
First, a vehicle–track interaction model is proposed by taking the hypotheses of wheel/rail rigid contact and displacement complementarity.
For example, with wheel-rail rigid contact assumption, no presentations of computer program have been provided to consider vehicle/track sepa-rations in three-dimensional (3D) space until now.

Railway engineering Vehicle-track interactions Versatile track model Finite element method Wheel-rail contacts A B S T R A C T Take hypothesis of wheel-rail rigid contact, this work presents a new method to characterize the vehicle-track interaction in the three-dimensional (3-D) space.
In this paper, a coupled approach to construct the vehicle-track interaction model is specifically proposed by further improving the models built upon the hypothesis of wheel-rail rigid contact.
